skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature and role of managerial accounting
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence and role of managerial accounting in businesses, distinguish between managerial accounting and financial accounting.
Analyze the relationship between costs, volume, and profit for decision-making purposes.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Building cost standards and production budgeting systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Construct cost standards and production budgeting systems for businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing variances between actual and budgeted figures
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the significance of cost standards in evaluating operational efficiency and analyze specific variances between actual and budgeted figures.
Develop proficiency in working independently and in teams.
Demonstrate self-management and take responsibility for personal learning outcomes.
